evidence: SnO2 ALD was performed at 150 oC using alternating TDMASn and H2O exposures in an ABAB... sequence: OH*Sn(DMA)2→*O Sn(DMA)2+ xHDMA, O Sn(DMA)2+2H2O→O Sn(OH)2+4−xHDMA+O, where the asterisks represent the surface species. The typical growth rate for the SnO2 ALD chemistry is ~0.6 Å per cycle, 34 and thus the thickness of SnO2 film can be well controlled at the nanometer scale by ALD cycles. The SnO2 ALD reaction sequence was: i) TDMASn dose to 1.0 Torr; ii) evacuation of reaction products and excess TDMASn with N2 purging; iii) H2O dose to 1.0 Torr; and iv) evacuation of reaction products and excess H2O with N2 purging.
